string.text:
ヴァシリエフ「ラボX16の入口の座標はこれだ。入口は中央の建物の地下にある。建物本来の用途は不明だが、地下の放射装置を整備する施設だった可能性がある。N***の資料によると、この計画の目的は、広範囲に作用するサイ兵器の本格開発であり……
……
必要な書類はすべて確保した。放射装置の止め方も分かった。ゴーストと研究所へ下りる。至る所からゾンビが出てくる……
……
何もかも最悪だ。ゴーストは完全に正気を失い、うわごとを言っている。放射にやられたらしい。すべてを放り出して、トンネルを通って退却を始めた……
……
沼地に出た。バンカーはどこだ？ くそ、くそ、くそ！ 自分の位置が分からない！ 臆病者のサハロフも応答しない！ どうなっているんだ？ 至る所にゾンビがいる。弾も尽きかけている……」
サハロフ「まずヴァシリエフの遺体を見つけ、研究所の正確な位置を突き止めてほしい。それから研究所に入り、ゴーストを探すんだ。彼は放射の止め方と、その後の脱出方法を知っていた」
サハロフ「私たちの研究員と一緒に測定をしてくれれば、調整済みの試作装置を渡そう。それがあれば研究所の中へ入れるはずだ」
サハロフ「私たちの研究員と一緒に測定をしてくれれば、調整済みの試作装置を渡そう。それがあれば研究所の中へ入れるはずだ」
サハロフ「よくやった、マーケッド・ワン。ついに研究所へたどり着いたね。そこにある装置の調査は、私たちにとって極めて重要だ。調べられるよう、停止させてほしい。 \n \nいいか、試作装置では強い放射から完全には身を守れない。その事態に備えて、防護装備にはタイマーを組み込んである。強い放射を浴びると作動し、時間が切れれば防護も失われる。くれぐれも慎重に。タイマーを忘れないでくれ」
装置は停止した。あとは生きてここから脱出するだけだ。
ゴースト「ガイド、そっちへ1人向かわせる。ドクターに伝える重要な情報がある。力を貸してやってくれ」 \n \nガイド「分かった。だが、ゴースト、前回のようなことは御免だぞ。お前自身も来い。前から話したいと思っていたんだ。いつもの場所、橋のそばのキャンプで待っている。道に迷うなよ。それと、軍の巡回部隊に捕まるな」
サハロフ「何があった？ 彼は死んだのか？ 測定データを回収して、すぐに戻ってくれ！」

I'm shocked! Ghost is the same person as the man on the photo found on my PDA, the very same photo attached to the task of killing the Strelok. I'm thoroughly confused. Whoever uploaded this task onto my PDA must have made a mistake, but who could it have been? There is no answer yet. From Ghost's records I learned the name of their "mutual acquaintance" - the fourth man in Strelok's group - Doctor. He has been helping the group for a long time playing the role of their "coordinator". He can be found through a stalker by the name of Guide, who frequents Cordon. Alright, Guide, just don't go dying all of a sudden... at least not before we meet. On Ghost's dead body I also found documents regarding the "Psi-Brain" mechanism. The whole neighborhood was under the influence of that piece of trash - it zombified everyone who came within range. I learned that there is another such mechanism in Lab X-10, and that's what is likely to be the Brain Scorcher. I also learned that these mechanisms are not always capable of operating at full strength. There are regular intervals when their power is automatically decreased to allow the apparatus to cool down.

After turning off that horrible "brain in a tube" I fell unconscious. The pressure of the last few days must have taken its toll. While I was out, I had a dream... A photograph. A gray-haired man is holding it in his hands and a huge dog is at his feet. The man is looking into the distance, but around him there is only a swamp; the landscape doesn't look at all like what's on the photo. In the fog I can see the silhouette of someone walking away. The man is talking to himself: "If it's so important, why didn't you tell me what this place is and where you got the photo"... then... on the side I see a smiling young man standing on the threshold of the cabin, who says cheerfully: "If only you knew where I was and what I saw there!" He extends his arm holding a marvelous device which lights up the whole cabin. The dog starts to growl and squeezes into a corner; the gray-haired man mumbles: "Some day these games will spell trouble for you." ...flash... the same young man with his face covered in blood stumbles inside the cabin door and falls... Lightning flashes in the sky, heavy rain is pouring down ...flash... The cabin bed with the young man covered in bandages. He is unconscious; the gray-haired man mumbles: "Hang in there, son". Some personal things are piled in a corner and among them there is that strange photo ...flash... the photo is in the hands of the gray-haired man. The young man, now with scars on his face, is about to leave. The gray-haired man asks him: "Where are you off to now?". The gloomy answer follows: "The North"...flash... then I woke up.

So, here I am just one step away from one of Strelok's men. Ghost went to the underground Lab X-16 with one of the scientists. There is only one "but" - I'm not likely to find him alive. The scientist was coming back from there alone and was killed when approaching the camp. I was given some kind of device to protect me against these obscure emissions. I hope it works. They want me to get inside and unplug the emitter - then they will be able to study it on site. God help me.

Entry #257
 >>Guide, I am sending someone to meet you. We have important information for Doctor, help him out
 >>> Good. But, Ghost, let's not repeat what happened last time. You come yourself, I've wanted to have a chat with you for a while. I'll be waiting at the usual place, in the camp near the bridge. Don't get lost and don't let the army patrols catch you." 
 
Entry #384
 …At the last moment, Vasiliev chickened out and instead of unplugging the lower console, he just ran off when the door opened. I shouldn't have relied on him - Strelok was right not to trust these lying dogs. My only chance is to reach the door before the controller...

...these are the co-ordinates of the entrance to Lab X-16. The entrance is located in the basement of the central building; the building's original purpose is unknown. It's possible it was used for the technical servicing of the underground emitters: based on the documentation from N***, the intended purpose of this project is the full-scale development of psychotronic weapons with a large area of effect on...
...
 ...all the necessary documents are in our possession and we know how to turn off the emitter. We're going down inside the lab with Ghost. Zombies are coming out from everywhere...
...
 ...everything is going to the dogs, Ghost has gone absolutely insane and is delirious. Looks like he's succumbed to the emission. I've abandoned everything and started to retreat back through the tunnels...
...
 ...I'm in the swamps, where's the bunker? Damn, damn, damn!!! I can't pinpoint my location! That coward Sakharov isn't responding!!! What's happening??? ...zombies are everywhere and I'm running out of ammo...

I'm torn between two things. It seems that the expedition is suspended, but at the same time it is necessary to be on the alert, because the order to leave can come at any moment. Then a profitable opportunity comes along: as I sit with Bosman near the Yantar scientist camp, taking potshots at the zombies, suddenly one of the eggheads from the bunker comes out and asks us to fetch an artifact for him. Said he'd go himself but he's shit scared so he'll gladly pay us to do it, since we look like professionals and all. Before I could begin to decline, the smarty pants pulls out a bundle of green. Bosman wasn't swayed by the sight of the money and insisted on remaining in position, we almost fought over it until our bespectacled friend intervened and said that only one of us would be sufficient to escort him. I agreed to go solo despite Bosman's objections, eventually he just spat at my boots and said: "Fuck you and your money, that's all you ever think about!" Anyway, I went with the egghead to protect him and stayed in touch with Bosman via the PDA. It's okay, we'll fight and make up a hundred times over in the future, he'll change his mind about my reckless moneymaking urges when I buy him a drink or two at the bar. \n\n %c[255,255,128,0]I stashed something north-east of the entrance to the factory, under a small dry bush in the middle of three large trees. The zombies and the radiation will discourage anyone from poking around.%c[default]

This moron, Aborigen, violated direct orders out of lust for money. I told him: "We must sit tight and await further orders from the Captain, at any moment we could receive orders to resume the expedition!" And this fool was like, "Don't be stupid, Bots, it's a simple job, you gotta take risks from time to time if you wanna get rich!" He was just trying to get at me. We drank together many times, he heard my life story time and time again and knew exactly how to push my buttons... Well, if that's how he wants to be, then fuck him. Let him go get the damn artifact, he'll be the one left behind when the expedition resumes! \n\n %c[255,255,128,0]I haven't seen that jerk in half a day. I haven't seen the scientist either... They're in the swamp behind the science bunker, and I've set up a stash near some pipe debris there. I just wanted to make sure my stuff didn't get damp...%c[default]
